fcfcc48d.name: Habit Loop Detection — Cue-Routine-Reward Mapping
fcfcc48d.description: Identify dominant habit loops from daily activity logs and measure intervention success.

hypothesis.statement: AI-detected habit cues match self-reported patterns ≥80% of the time

989d06d7.name: Cognitive Bias Nudge — Pre-Decision Framing
989d06d7.description: Test whether presenting a bias warning before decisions reduces loss-aversion and anchoring effects.

hypothesis.statement: Bias framing nudges improve decision quality score by ≥15%

360b5814.name: Impulse Filter Effectiveness — Delay Intervention
360b5814.description: Measure whether a 10-minute delay prompt reduces impulsive decisions flagged by the impulse filter.

hypothesis.statement: 10-minute delay prompts reduce impulsive action rate by ≥25%
